correlationId.description: Client-generated UUID v4 used to correlate each request/response pair.

minDistanceParsec.description: Inclusive lower distance bound. When set, entries with unknown distance are excluded. Must not exceed maxDistanceParsec.

search.description: Literal substring search across system id, displayName, settlementName, catalogName, aliases, and primary-star properName/spectralType. Any non-whitespace length is supported, including one or two characters. Matching normalizes Unicode to NFC, collapses whitespace, and applies toLocaleLowerCase('en-US'); it does not remove accents, transliterate, or fold scripts. Regex metacharacters are literal.

minPlanetCount.description: Only systems with at least this many catalog planets; 1 means has planets. 0 or omitted applies no filter.

spectralClass.description: Primary-star spectral class letter (for example G or M), case-insensitive.

sort.description: distance (default): distanceParsec ascending with unknown distances last, then id. name: case- and accent-insensitive, numeric-aware name order, then id.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first item to return after filtering and sorting. An offset at or past total returns an empty page with success true.

limit.description: Page size. Defaults to 100; values above 500 are clamped to 500. Non-integers and values below 1 fail.
